gaps: Existing Outreach API docs expose raw HTTP surfaces; this print packages command discovery, agent defaults, local sync/search, SQL analytics, and MCP access.
patterns: Sales engagement workflows benefit from compact JSON, --agent defaults, local SQLite mirrors, deterministic command discovery, and read-first MCP tools.
